Можно вскрыть запертый сундук — если пов: Can pick a locked chest — with some luck.
You can push off the air once more.
A prayer written down by a holy hermit.

Монстры крепче и злее, элиты встречаются:
Monsters are tougher and angrier, elites appear more often. More gold and experience.
Sanctum shards: ×1.5
Монстры не видят вас, пока вы не нападёт: Monsters can't see you until you attack or bump into them.
Монстры слабее и бьют мягче. Для знакомс:
Monsters are weaker and hit softer. For getting to know the dungeon.
Sanctum shards: ×0.5
Мощь некроманта растёт, удары чаще наход: The necromancer's power grows, blows find their mark more often.
Мы откололи кусок сердца. Каменный просн: We chipped off a piece of the heart. The Stone One woke. He wasn't angry — he screamed in pain, and the ceiling fell with his scream. The mountain is not a mountain. It is a seal. The Stone One is its lock. And we stole the key.
Мы сожгли кости Олдрика, как велел корол: We burned Oldric's bones, as the king commanded. The fire went on for three days. On the fourth, black heat breathed from below, and the ashes... rose. His service in life was not enough for the Eclipse. It chose to wring him out to the last spark — and fanned the embers into a new body.
A thought sharper than any blade.
Soft metal, but it doesn't rust.
The dead rise as a squad and follow you.
Набросок ходов этого этажа. Сгорает посл: A sketch of this floor's passages. Burns after reading.
A reliable blade of the underground smiths.
Found in the walls of the dungeon.
At last... peace in the ashes.
The tip is forged from dragon scale.
Нашли жилу лунного кристалла. Светится с: Found a vein of moon crystal. It glows on its own, no torch needed. It rings when struck. The old men say these are the mountain's tears — it has wept ever since the black sun fell into it. They pay triple. We dig.
Keep the hilt from chafing your hands.
The heavens fall upon the wicked.
Некромант выпивает силы: лечение и прили: The necromancer drains life: healing and a surge of power.
Некромант становится личом: мощь, стойко: The necromancer becomes a lich: power, resilience and healing.
Некромант, поднимающий скелетов. Убейте: A necromancer who raises skeletons. Kill it first.
A little gold at the start of every run.
Неупокоенная душа. Проходит сквозь стены: A restless soul. Passes through walls and fears no poison.
Новое солнце зажглось, Эльза. На один ми: The new sun lit up, Elsa. For one moment. Then the black one drank it like water, and the sorceress screamed so that the anvils cracked. She didn't die. She is burning still and cannot burn away. Don't wait for me.
Your feet carry you faster than the wind.
Your feet carry you forward on their own.
A charm made from the bones of underground beasts.
A vow that not even death can take.
A cloud of plague around the necromancer.
A poison cloud eats enemies from within.
A fiery strike from the heavens around the mage.
Огромный голем из костей бьёт по площади: A huge bone golem that hits an area.
